messages:
Mira Chen: quick thread — I ran a short profiler on the 13B+7B co-residency experiment and saw a surprising kernel fallback pattern that spikes working_set and triggers soft OOMs when batches overlap. attaching snippets below.

Mira Chen: reproduction: steady 512-token seq, bursty concurrent requests (p50 latency 60ms) — starting at t+70s we get repeated fallbacks to slower attention kernel and workspace growth.

Mira Chen: profiler dump:```
kernel_choice: fast_attn_fused (preferred)
fallback: attention_blocked_kernel -> attention_generic_v2
workspace_bytes: 4.1G -> 7.9G
kv_cache_bytes: 1.2G
concurrent_streams: 6
heap_fragmentation_pct: 34
CUDA_ERROR: out of memory (soft)
```

Dave Patel: ugh. did you see if the kernel selector is re-evaluating per-request or per-batch-window?

Mira Chen: per-batch-window. selector picks based on seq_len distribution + tile_size heuristic. fallback occurs after an attempted launch fails with a temp allocation. looks like allocation retry path rebinds to generic kernel but preserves the larger workspace reservation.

Jonah Rivera: could be allocator fragmentation + the way we pre-reserve workspace for fused kernel. if we pre-reserve then fallback -> we never shrink reservation until GC window.

Priya Singh: can you paste the exact OOM log from the serving runtime?

Mira Chen: snippet:```
[2025-06-03T14:12:10Z] serve-runtime: attempt_launch(model=13B, kernel=fast_attn_fused)
[2025-06-03T14:12:10Z] serve-runtime: alloc failed for temp_workspace 2.8G -> retry with attention_generic_v2
[2025-06-03T14:12:10Z] serve-runtime: switched kernel -> generic, kept reservation 4.8G
[2025-06-03T14:12:11Z] CUDA: out of memory while allocating 512MB (target pool)
```

Priya Singh: makes sense — reservation stickiness is the issue. For multi-model (13B+7B) we need a smaller initial workspace guess and fast shrink on fallback.

Dave Patel: agreed. options: 1) make workspace reservation elastic (lease with TTL) 2) on fallback, trigger immediate shrink-to-fit if over threshold 3) fallback to kernel that uses a streaming-friendly workspace (lower peak)

Jonah Rivera: also worth exploring prefetch-on-cold-start for KV cache but with capped pre-alloc. current kv prewarm grabs whole model KV and collides with workspace during bursts.

Mira Chen: yes, kv prewarm hits ~1.2G for 13B. if two models prewarm simultaneously + workspace bump -> overlap. Suggest limiting kv prefetch concurrency to 1 per GPU and do async streaming of older layers.

SRE-Jen: +1 on limiting concurrency. from SLO side we prefer graceful degraded latency over soft OOMs and worker restarts.

Priya Singh: quick config patch I'd like to try (pseudo):```yaml
allocator:
  elastic_workspace:
    enabled: true
    initial_bytes: 512MB
    max_bytes: 6GB
    shrink_on_fallback: true
    shrink_threshold_pct: 60
kv_cache:
  prefetch:
    concurrency: 1
    max_initial_bytes: 800MB
```

Mira Chen: nice. another knob: batching heuristic horizon. if we shorten the batching window from 50ms -> 20ms we reduce overlap probability (fewer concurrent microbatches), at cost of slight throughput drop. Could run A/B to measure unit cost.

Dave Patel: and kernel selection change: prefer kernel with deterministic small workspace for co-residency tier. maybe tag a kernel_profile: {peak: X, prefer_when_cohost: true}. runtime can prefer small-peak kernels when co-residency policy=packed.

Jonah Rivera: implementation note: kernel metadata needs to include 'workspace_upper_bound' computed from profiling (median+4*sigma). we can store per-model per-kernel stats in the model profile.

Mira Chen: I instrumented a small sim: with elastic_workspace + kv prefetch concurrency=1 + batch_horizon=20ms, co-residency success rate (no soft OOM) rose from 72% -> 97% on a 1000-req synthetic run. latency p95 increased ~8ms.

Mira Chen: next steps: Priya can you spin a dev cluster build with the allocator patch? Jonah can add kernel metadata field to profiler. Dave will run a 1h mixed workload experiment with batch_horizon tweak. I'll gather logs and perf-bot will annotate regressions.

perf-bot: scheduled perf-run: mixed-13b-7b-1hr on dev-gpupool-2 at 2025-06-03T18:00:00Z. post-run will upload flamegraphs to /artifacts/perf/1749284321.

Priya Singh: starting build now, will post the image tag when done.

Dave Patel: tagging @Jonah for kernel metadata PR. also adding a short unit test that forces fallback and checks reservation shrink.

Mira Chen: thanks all. keeping this thread as the single place for logs. if we still see fragmentation after these changes we might need to evaluate a per-model soft-isolation boundary (slice windows) as a last resort. :ok_hand:

Jonah Rivera: noted. I'll prototype kernel metadata export today.

Priya Singh: image pushed: registry.internal/redwood/serve:cohost-elastic-20250603-rc1

SRE-Jen: I'll watch the dev run and escalate if any infra restarts happen.

Mira Chen: perfect. i'll kick the perf-bot run once the PRs land and we have the image.

Dave Patel: cheers — scoreboard: elastic allocator + kv cap + shorter batch horizon -> high chance to avoid OOMs while keeping decent throughput.

Mira Chen: closing loop once we have perf graphs.
